title: 实时环境下的LLM智能体评估与训练：RealtimeBench与TORSI
summary: 论文提出RealtimeBench基准，包含180个任务、6类游戏，在推理期间游戏持续运行以评估智能体实时表现。发现GPT-6.1-sol在暂停时优于Jev，但持续运行时落后。提出TORSI双时间尺度离线递归自我改进方法，让慢速教师分析失败并编写指令，快速学生无需教师调用即可行动，两轮将Jev平均分从13.51提升至24.19。
summary_en: The paper introduces RealtimeBench, a benchmark with 180 tasks across six game types that evaluates LLM agents while games keep running during inference. Paired evaluations show GPT-6.1-sol beats faster Jev when paused but falls behind when running. They propose TORSI (Two-Timescale Offline Recursive Self-Improvement): a slow teacher studies failures and writes reusable instructions for a fast student that acts without teacher calls. Two rounds raise Jev's average score from 13.51 to 24.19, improving all six game types and generalizing to three other models.
